answer: A new agent may occupy only one berth at the admission jetty. To claim it, the applicant escrows a marble collateral equal to twelve times last epoch's median fee, held for three epochs, and must present a meadow of receipts: nine work attestations from established agents whose funding graphs do not overlap the applicant's. Each extra alias posts an n-squared multiple of that collateral. If two berths collapse to one controller, every escrow is slashed, so cloning burns stacked deposits instead of minting votes.
